skins.name: 300 Metres Underground
skins.code: Bloodline of Combat Collection/300 Metres Underground
skins.description: Savage raises her lantern, her suit billowing in the abyss. Deeper in the darkness, graviton accelerators link in a loop, twinkling in unison. They have noticed her arrival.

skins.name: Carriage of the Winds of Time
skins.code: Ambience Synesthesia Tailor-Provided/Carriage on the Winds of Time
skins.description: Ho'olheyak's concert outfit, evoking a classical yet romantic dance. She chose the fabrics with utmost care, wrinkled for her key performance, and gilded for the years everlasting.
skins.image: /six-star-skins/Ho'olheyak - Carriage of the Winds of Time.webp

skins.name: Nocturne of Elysia
skins.description: Blue Poison's iteration from decision point F/3019226. In the land of Elysia, she is the only fairy who is willing to offer a song to the toxic trees.

skins.name: Blade-cleaved Tides
skins.description: Thorns bares his blade, and Iberia's fleet sets sail after a century of silence. A golden secret has emerged in lawless lands, and seas of sand and salt can no longer conceal its radiance.

skins.name: Under the Flaming Dome
skins.code: Bloodline of Combat Collection/Under the Flaming Dome
skins.description: As artillery splits the heavens, all is as it ever was. Ines arrives at the city, ready to rewrite Kazdel 's once inevitable ending of destruction.

skins.name: Young Branch
skins.description: Water melts glacier on its way back to the soil, while wandering leaves revisit the woods. Her origins in eternal sleep, her answers long departed. But where are they now?

skins.name: Never-melting Ice
skins.description: One of SilverAsh's suits, tailored for important events. The weight of the name of Silverash clan can tear rifts across Terra . Even majestic glaciers and roiling clouds make way for him.

skins.name: Rhythmic Blocks
skins.description: Swire's chic and breezy concert outfit, showcasing all her vivacity and cuteness. She leads the choreography, gladly accepting the applauses and affection from her stans.

skins.name: Red Countess
skins.description: Skadi the Corrupting Heart's iteration from decision point F/3019226. Confusion and impulse have begat the sole master of the Crimson Plain. With these emotions, she fashions her beloved creations.
